The '''Emmer system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Emmer]], which featured glowing grasslands and urban sprawls. It was also home to an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] known as the [[Emmer system asteroid belt|Emmer Belt]].
